notes.title: Controls Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improved the smooth move and smooth turning. Left controller is now used for forward/backward and strafing movement, and right controller for turning/pivoting. 
[*]Added some new custom bindings for Oculus Touch and Index Knuckles controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Hotfix for Contract Signing Achievement
notes.content: Contract signing achievement should now fire off correctly

notes.title: Contract Signing Bug Hotfix
notes.content:
I put out a potential fix for the contract signing bug. I haven't been able to recreate it on my end, so I'd appreciate feedback from players who were experiencing this to let me know if it's solved!
Thanks,
Samuel

notes.title: Sentenced Gets a Trailer!
notes.content:
Hello World! 
First post on this brand new Steam Page!
Thought I'd use the opportunity to announce that Sentenced got it's first trailer today, and that you can watch it [url=https://youtu.be/ZUtVl07jHYo]here[/url]
If you want to follow me for future development updates you can catch me on my website, [url=https://sentencedvr.com/][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/SamTheSane]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/samthesane/]Instagram![/url]
It's a pleasure to beheading on this journey with you.
- Samuel
